profile.headline: Senior Solutions Engineer
profile.summary:
As an ever evolving Senior Solutions Engineer, we seem to find ourselves at an inflection point, one that requires extreme fluidity & change.  It is being called the ‘Productivity Wave’.  As hyperscalers push for any competitive edge and scramble to grab the latest news cycle; the rest of us sit back and ask, ‘How do I catch up?”  As engineers we are expected to shift with the times; we are expected to change.  If not, then we find ourselves left behind and no longer marketable. My career path represents that ‘Philosophy of Change’.  
  
From old Legacy Systems to Bleeding Edge Technology I have observed first-hand how technology borrows from itself, builds on top of itself.  I have had the luxury of working within Scalable backend architectures, RESTful API design patterns, Cloud-first ecosystems, CI/CD Pipelines, Legacy Migration Conversions, and Lift & Shift Initiatives.  All to drive enterprise efficiency and performance through automation and reusability. 
  
Recently acquired AI Workflow Automation, Mastery & Python (PCEP) Associate Certifications, I find myself actively engaged within the latest concepts to accelerate software development velocity.  OpenAI’s IDE Codex has been rather exhilarating.  So much so, I found myself entering the 2026 Handshake OpenAI Codex Challenge.  I am also currently attending the University of Southern Florida's AI Automation Workflow Curriculum.  It is a 5 week curriculum and we currently find ourselves on week three.  It has been fascinating to learn what n8n, Make.com, and Zapier Automation Platforms have introduced to industry.

positions.title: Fellowship - AI Model Image | Accuracy | Composition | Technical Trainer
positions.description:
•  Evaluating and refining multimodal AI model 
      outputs for frontier research labs, focusing on 
      one of the following; image/accuracy/composition/technical rendering.
	  
•  Actions: Engineered a suite of full-stack applications and data visualization tools for the 2026 Handshake OpenAI Codex Creator Challenge. 
•  Context: Developed a series of Single Page Web Apps (SPAs) focused on infrastructure automation, data analysis, and recruitment technology. 
•  Results:  Significant improvement in overall SDLC turn-around time.  
   o  Financial News Screener across multiple RSS Feeds & Filter Functionality
   o  Employment Portal Screener with ATS Validation & Dice Integration
   o  Job Description Technical Assessment Generator
   o  AWS infrastructure Decision Utility
   o  Individual Options Trading Suite - Charles Schwab
•  Actions: Architected and deployed multi-path automation workflow pipelines using n8n and Make.com integrated with OpenAI GPT. 
•  Context: Streamlining data extraction, social media syndication, and customer support operations through low-code and AI integrations. 
•  Results:
   o  Automated Hacker News Scraper via n8n, process insights through GPT, and publish directly to the Bluesky pipeline.
   o  Autonomous Task Management Make.com multi-path assistant connecting Telegram to Google Workspace (Mail/Calendar).
   o  Automated Order-Tracking Bot and a Receipt Tracking System that extracts data from Gmail images via GPT and populates Google Sheets automatically.
•  Actions: Engaged in continuous "on-the-bench" technical upskilling and certification programs. 
•  Context: Maintaining alignment with rapidly evolving industry standards in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. 
•  Results: Successfully adapted technical stack to meet modern AI enterprise requirements, supported by a portfolio of relevant industry certifications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Platform & API)
positions.locationName: Lake Mary, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
University of Phoenix (UOPX) | Lake Mary, FL
Cloud Platform Engineer (Full-Time) | 05/2023 – 08/2025
Senior JAVA Engineer (Contract via Insight Global) | 11/2022 – 05/2023

• Enterprise Modernization: Led the critical migration from Spring Boot 2.x to 3.x and Java 7 to 11/17/21, significantly reducing technical debt and improving system security across organizational Maven builds.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Designed and provisioned scalable AWS resources (EKS, ECS, EC2) using Terraform and Spacelift, implementing Python-based validation to automate IaC modularization and compliance checkpoints.

• Microservices & RESTFUL API Architecture: Developed and deployed domain-driven Funding & Documents Management Microservices from the ground up using JAVA, Spring Boot, AWS S3, AWS SDK,  and Kafka (MSK), optimizing API consumption and sunsetting legacy processes.

• CI/CD Optimization: Engineered robust GitHub Actions in association to BitBucket Repositorities, with respect to AWS Codebuild, Codedeploy Pipelines for mission-critical third-party software (Flowable, Documentum), reducing deployment friction and accelerating time-to-market.

• Security & Identity: Orchestrated Microsoft Entra ID (SSO) integration for multi-tenant environments, managing OAuth2 scopes, permissions, and JWT-based authentication for exposed APIs.

• Observability & Monitoring: Implemented platform logging standards using New Relic and JSON formatting, providing real-time structured performance data and reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR).  Stood up multiple New Relic Dashboards monitoring microservice throughput, latency, and time variances for consuming applications and or end users.

• Technical Leadership: Authored comprehensive technical documentation in Confluence and mentored junior engineers, eliminating knowledge silos and accelerating team onboarding during rapid growth phases.

• AI Engineering: Prompt Coding within corporate hackathon. Produced Single HTML Page with JIRA Data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud SecDevOps)
positions.description:
Kemper (via Insight Global) | Jacksonville, FL
Senior Software Engineer - Cloud SecDevOps (Contract) | 03/2022 – 08/2022

• Container Security Innovation: Led a high-impact Proof of Concept (PoC) implementing AWS Pod-Level Security Groups, achieving granular network isolation and a hardened security posture for containerized workloads.

• DevSecOps Automation: Designed and integrated JFrog X-Ray vulnerability scanning into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; engineered custom abstractions using Groovy Shared Libraries to automate security gates for Docker images.

• Cloud Infrastructure Support: Provided Tier-3 DevOps production support, managing AWS infrastructure (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM) and maintaining enterprise Jenkins pipelines to ensure 24/7 system availability.

• Pipeline Standardization: Accelerated project onboarding by developing CI/CD Pipeline Boilerplates, reducing manual configuration time for new engineering teams and ensuring governance compliance.

• Technical Documentation & Knowledge Base: Authored comprehensive developer reference materials, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), PoC lesson-learned repositories, and troubleshooting guides in Confluence to reduce future support overhead.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Allstate | Jacksonville, FL
Lead Software Engineer | 03/2019 – 03/2022

• Enterprise Orchestration: Architected and delivered a high-availability Jenkins/Groovy Deployment Pipeline managing 52 Docker images across 12 Kubernetes namespaces, automating release cycles for the V3 AIM/Billing enterprise application.

• Data Engineering & Governance: Provided expert-level Database Administration (Oracle PL/SQL & SQL Server), leading data modeling, normalization, and conversion efforts to support high-volume microservice transactions.

• Testing Innovation: Engineered a custom WireMock Framework (Spring Boot/Java) adopted as an enterprise standard to simulate complex API dependencies, increasing developer velocity and reducing environment bottlenecks.

• Legacy Modernization: Spearheaded the integration of ZOS Connect into Allstate’s BatchCard Services, successfully bridging mission-critical legacy mainframe systems with a modern RESTful Microservice architecture.

• Observability & PoC Leadership: Directed Proof of Concept (PoC) initiatives for the CI/CD paradigm and implemented the Splunk Monitoring Framework to establish real-time observability across the production environment.

• Agile Leadership: Served as Technical Lead for one of the company's first "Transformative Growth" initiatives, mentoring cross-functional teams on RESTful Design, CI/CD paradigms, and Gradle/Maven best practices.

• Technical Governance: Authored foundational Architecture & Design papers and governance guidelines in Confluence, providing a roadmap for both executive leadership and engineering teams during 2-week Agile sprints.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collabera (Contract) | Orlando, FL
Senior Software Engineer | 05/2018 – 03/2019

• Greenfield JavaFX/Java Application Architecture: Engineered a mission-critical Live Fire Weapons Assessment desktop application, from the ground up, for the Government of Egypt (GoE); successfully translated complex Statements of Work (SOW) into a high-performance functional application.

• Core Framework Development: Designed and implemented a secure Model-View-Controller (MVC) framework using JavaFX, creating robust CRUD interfaces and data-binding layers to meet rigorous international client specifications.

• Distributed Messaging: Integrated a RabbitMQ Interface Service Handler to establish a decoupled, asynchronous communication layer, ensuring reliable data delivery for specialized real-time assessment functionality.

• Engineering Excellence: Standardized development workflows by enforcing Google Development Standards and OOD/OOP principles, utilizing IntelliJ-driven quality gates to ensure long-term maintainability.

• Technical Mentorship: Led peer code reviews and introduced Usability Metrics, shifting the team’s focus toward user-centric design and reducing post-delivery UI/UX defects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Apex Systems (Contract) | Orlando, FL
Senior Software Engineer | 10/2017 – 04/2018

• Mission-Critical Systems Development: Engineered core enhancements for the F-35 Autonomic Logistics Information System (ALIS), a global CMMS platform managing maintenance and logistics for the Department of Defense’s premier fighter jet program.

• Complex Data Modeling: Delivered high-integrity features for Inventory, Bill of Materials (BOM), and Unit Maintenance History modules, ensuring 100% accuracy in tracking mission-critical defense assets and assembly lifecycles.

• Systems Integration: Leveraged Java, JDBC, and MQ to modernize legacy data flows, facilitating seamless communication between logistics modules and external scheduling interfaces.

• Interdepartmental Technical Liaison: Acted as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to bridge communication between field personnel and engineering teams, translating customer requirements into automated build processes.

• Legacy Modernization & Support: Optimized web application performance within a WebSphere (WAS) environment, streamlining XML-based data exchanges and SQL Server database queries.

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
OneMain Financial (Contract) | Evansville, IN
Senior Backend Engineer | 01/2017 – 09/2017

• High-Availability API Engineering: Architected and deployed 24/7 JAVA RESTful APIs for the Personal Loans division, enabling real-time data analytics for automotive repossession and risk mitigation workflows.

• Financial Transaction Integrity: Managed core services governing eSignature and Mobius Document Handling, ensuring the compliant execution and digital archival of high-volume loan contracts.

• Service Modernization: Enhanced legacy business process flows by implementing modern Spring Boot and Jersey frameworks, improving system response times for critical asset recovery reporting.

• Quality & Risk Mitigation: Spearheaded comprehensive unit and regression testing strategies using SOAP UI and JUnit, delivering documented test plans that satisfied strict financial auditing requirements.

• Enterprise Data Integration: Optimized complex data exchanges between DB2, SQL Server, and MQ messaging layers, facilitating seamless data flow across the lending department’s distributed architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Heritage Services | Indianapolis, IN
Senior Software Engineer | 04/2015 – 08/2016

• Open Source Strategy & Cost Reduction: Spearheaded the transition from proprietary GIS software to Open Source technologies (Leaflet, OpenStreetMap), successfully reducing enterprise licensing costs and standardizing development conventions.

• Geospatial Engineering: Architected and deployed a GeoMapping enhancement that integrated customer and supplier datasets to identify untapped marketing opportunities, directly contributing to organizational sales growth.

• Algorithmic Optimization: Refined transportation and routing logic within the core Waste Management Web Application, resulting in measurable reductions in operational overhead and improved service delivery metrics.

• Financial Data Processing: Developed robust batch processing systems for multi-interval (monthly/quarterly/yearly) financial reporting, ensuring precise benefit calculations for Green Alternative Renewable Industry programs.

• Full-Stack Development: Leveraged Java, JavaScript (jQuery/Bootstrap), and Oracle PL/SQL to deliver end-to-end features in a high-availability environment, maintaining strict data integrity for client financials.

projects.title: AI Programming with Python Nanodegree
projects.description:
AI Programming with Python - Nanodegree 

Successful completion of a 3 month curriculum.  You may find more information at https://udacity.com
Certificate of Completion: https://graduation.udacity.com/nd089

Reference GitHub Repositories (dl_nn_image_classifier, dl_nn_image_classifier_at_cmd_line)

Length of Program: 76 Days
Syllabus:
1: Introduction to AI Programming
2: Introduction to Python 
3: Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib
4: Linear Algebra
5: Calculus 
6: Neural Networks
7: Create Your Own Deep Learning Neural Network Image Classifier
